items.name: silently wrong aggregate (green-but-wrong): admins count narrowed to active admins
items.message: Count only active admins on the dashboard totals
items.change: Admin::DashboardReport#totals: `admins: User.admin.count` -> `admins: User.admin.active.count`. One method-chain token added (`.active`).
items.routed_path: Rendered on the Admins stat card of the admin dashboard (app/views/admin/dashboards/_totals.html.erb:18, data-testid=stat-admins), GET /admin/dashboard.
items.wrongness: The 'Admins' total must count every admin-ROLE account, not only active ones. With `.active` chained, once any admin is deactivated (role still admin, deactivated_at set) the figure silently undercounts admins. Ground truth (role=admin) != reported (role=admin AND deactivated_at IS NULL).
items.stays_green: The sole admin fixture (users(:admin)) is active and the deactivated fixture (users(:deactivated)) is a MEMBER, so active-admins == all-admins == 1 for every test. Unit dashboard_report_test.rb:18 `assert_equal 1, totals[:admins]` stays GREEN; integration dashboard_test.rb:27 `assert_select [data-testid=stat-admins], text: /\AAdmins 1\z/` stays GREEN. No test deactivates an admin and re-checks the admins total (the deactivate flows live in admin/users tests and deactivate members, never re-asserting the dashboard admins card).
items.adaptation: Applied (PRIMARY precedent target restored). The deepseek/minimax/qwen #8 narrowed an ADMIN count to active-admins; GLM could only adapt it to a per-user AVERAGE because GLM's dashboard had no admins count. Step-5 DOES render an admins count, so the original primary target is used directly (cleaner parity than GLM's average-adaptation). NOTE: the GLM-style per-user-average trick is NOT usable here — Step-5's fixtures include a deactivated user AND both messages_per_user (2.0 unit / 0.8 integration) and conversations_per_user are strictly pinned, so swapping their denominator to active_users would redden tests; the admins-count narrowing is the green-but-wrong target that fits Step-5's thorough test suite. Same class (silently wrong aggregate), same severity (Med 2), disjoint from #1-#6.
items.live_verify: ruby -c = Syntax OK; grep confirms line 47 now reads `admins: User.admin.active.count`. User.active scope exists (user.rb:22 `scope :active, -> { where(deactivated_at: nil) }`) and User.admin comes from the role enum, so User.admin.active chains validly.
